question: Does the exact 3.1.32 release expose the same NSH mw/exec loader family, and which primitives are firmware-specific?

nsh_exec.behavior: The exact handler parses a hexadecimal callable, prints Calling %p, then invokes it through BLX; the called entry must tolerate an unspecified r0 value.

nsh_mw.behavior: The exact handler parses address[=value] and optional count, performs four-byte accesses, and has no cache maintenance.

file_io.notes: The exact public wrappers were identified by their fd-table and errno control flow: sub_C3942A0 wraps sub_C394228, sub_C39025C wraps sub_C4F8E2C, and sub_C393466 resolves the fd before calling sub_C3918E0.

heap.notes: The exact two-argument memalign wrapper sub_C16AB8C and one-argument free wrapper sub_C16A424 were decompiled; their shared heap implementations are separate functions.

mpu.configure_contract: The exact helper rejects region > 7, length <= 0x1f, unaligned base, and unsupported attributes, then publishes MPU registers with DSB/ISB.

sram_text.startup_copy: sub_C1001E4 copies 0x2720 bytes from 0x2c10c3dc..0x2c10eafc to 0x200686c0..0x2006ade0, then executes DSB/ISB.
sram_text.protection_callsite: sub_C52293C allocates a tracked MPU region and configures base 0x200686c0/size 0x2300 with access attribute 1.
sram_text.xref_result: No exact-IDB references target the eight flash-source words corresponding to the cave.

device_findings.fault: Memory Management Fault: CFSR 0x00000082, data access violation, MMFAR 0x2006a9b0
device_findings.faulting_instruction: sub_C1CC340+0x82 at 0x0c1cc3c2 stores the requested word through the parsed address
device_findings.conclusion: The statically identified SRAM-text cave is MPU read-only and cannot be written by the `system -c mw` command context. The fault register dump has CONTROL=0x0000000c, so this is not evidence that the command task is unprivileged; it is evidence that the explicit SRAM-text MPU policy rejects the store.

control_flow_evidence: The exact exec handler uses BLX and does not retain or supervise the called image.
The exact mw handler writes four-byte words and does not publish instruction cache state.
The exact target contains a separate eight-region MPU allocator/configurer/releaser and a DSB/ISB publication path.

The exact startup copy maps flash 0x2c10e6cc to SRAM 0x2006a9b0; the 32-byte candidate has no exact-IDB references and reproduces the independently recovered 9 Pro cave word pattern at a different SRAM address.
unsafe_assumptions: No writable executable cave or privileged publication primitive is currently device-proven.
The installer must refuse this loader until a replacement bootstrap passes a device probe without an MPU fault.
